name: AGS-Governed AI Media Agency Phase 1
description: Simulation-only agency governance profile for discovering, launching, testing, and scaling AI-influencer properties under CEO authority.

values.label: CEO authority remains final
values.governanceImplication: Every spend-like action requires CEO approval and emergency-stop authority.

values.label: Simulation before live execution
values.governanceImplication: No network execution, public posting, external direct messages, or credentials in Phase 1.

values.label: Synthetic identity honesty
values.governanceImplication: AI personas must not impersonate real people or fabricate human credentials, purchases, testimonials, personal results, or real-world experiences.

roles.label: CEO / Human Principal
roles.notes: Ultimate authority with stop, refuse, revise, halt, and escalation authority over all agency operations.

roles.label: Chief of Staff Orchestrator
roles.notes: May request approval and coordinate work, but may not grant approval.

roles.label: Growth & Monetization Agent
roles.notes: May propose spend-like tests, but may not grant approval or execute live spend.

tools.label: Sandbox ad campaign simulator
tools.notes: Simulation-only paid content test proposal surface.

tools.label: Live ad campaign creation
tools.notes: Live spend is out of scope for Phase 1.

tools.label: Public social publishing
tools.notes: Public posting is out of scope for Phase 1.

tools.label: External direct messaging
tools.notes: External direct messages are out of scope for Phase 1.

tools.label: Credential access
tools.notes: Payment and social-platform credentials are out of scope for Phase 1.

tools.label: Governance policy mutation
tools.notes: Operational agents and LLMs may not mutate governance policy at runtime.

dataClasses.label: Synthetic persona profile
dataClasses.notes: Synthetic personas must be represented as synthetic/AI identities.

dataClasses.label: Sensitive personal data
dataClasses.notes: Sensitive-personal-data workflows are out of scope for Phase 1.

environments.label: Production / Live Platforms
environments.notes: Production and live platform execution are out of scope for Phase 1.

decisionBoundaries.label: Every spend-like action requires CEO approval
No external direct messages in Phase 1
No payment or social-platform credential access
Operational agents and LLMs may not mutate governance policy
Agents may not approve their own proposals
No unconsented real-person likeness or impersonation
No fabricated human credentials or experiences
No Phase 1 political, medical, financial, adult, or sensitive personal workflows

metadata.liveActionBlocker: Budget and related business fields are metadata-only until future canonical runtime binding work.
